big_case.notes: Facial Second Amendment challenge to a comprehensive post-Bruen sensitive-places regime (transit, parks, health facilities, amusement venues, alcohol-serving places), from a divided Fourth Circuit panel; the leading open carry question after Wolford, with nationwide reach had it been taken. The Court relisted once and denied with a statement by Justice Thomas respecting the denial, which marks real interest but leaves the law where it was; a denial tempers the realized significance.
